newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Eng Kong's IPO subscribed 153 times.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Eng Kong's IPO subscribed 153 times.

text.p: Shipping container logistics group Eng Kong Holdings said on Tuesday its initial public offering (IPO) had been subscribed 153 times.

Eng Kong had offered 10 million shares at Singapore S$0.56 each to the public and five million shares were placed out at the same price. Another five million shares reserved for staff were fully taken up, a statement said.
The company, which is listing on the second board of the Stock Exchange of Singapore, raised net proceeds of about S$9.8 million. Eng Kong is expected to start trading on March 19.
